title: POST /api/client/leave
description: REST twin of WS client_leave for a device without a hub socket: the watch signs itself off through its phone or directly over the pinned TLS port. Authorization: Bearer <client secret> of the device itself; 401 for an unknown, revoked or deleted device. client_id must be the device of the secret, otherwise 422 and nothing changes. The hub removes the device like client_leave (no tombstone, HA user removed by the integration, client_kicked {reason: left}, audit client_left) and answers 200 client_leave_ok.
